title: Which bracket tool for a 64-team online cup?
body: An online cup with 64 teams strains free tiers and spreadsheet brackets: check-in, match reporting, disputes and a public bracket all need to work. Which tool have you used at that size, and what broke?

The [Bracket HQ pricing page](https://brackethq.com/pricing/) says the free tier is ad supported with unlimited brackets of up to 32 participants, while Pro allows up to 64 participants. The [start.gg site](https://www.start.gg) describes a destination to create, run, play and watch esports tournaments, and the [Challengermode site](https://www.challengermode.com) describes a competition management platform covering tournaments and matchmaking.
Share the format you ran, how you handled no-shows and score disputes, and whether the tool could connect to your game for results.
